edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Low thyroid hormone slows neural metabolism and information processing, which explains the cognitive dulling seen in untreated overt disease.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2025 Mohamed meta analysis in Thyroid Res, which ties overt hypothyroidism to cognitive function in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
